fundamental_action_reconstruction/STRICT_EQUATION_SHEET_KERNEL_TO_LTOTAL_CURRENT.md:1775:## P2520/S1470 endpoint-anchor subkey lattice certificate

fundamental_action_reconstruction/STRICT_EQUATION_SHEET_KERNEL_TO_LTOTAL_CURRENT.md:1777:`P2520/S1470` refines the P2519 conditional endpoint-anchor acceptance result into a rank/subkey lattice.  The numeric anchor target decomposes into two independent endpoint source obligations: the left beta-normalization anchor `y(0)=0`, and the right endpoint value anchor `y(log 11)=(4/5)log 11`.  The affine constraint matrix has rank/nullity profile: no anchors leaves `(b,a)` two-dimensional, the left anchor fixes `b=0` but leaves slope free, the right anchor leaves a one-parameter intercept/slope tradeoff, and only both anchors give rank 2 and the unique target `b=0, a=4/5`, hence `beta=1, eta=9/5`.

fundamental_action_reconstruction/STRICT_EQUATION_SHEET_KERNEL_TO_LTOTAL_CURRENT.md:1783:`P2521/S1471` refines the P2520 endpoint-subkey lattice by separating endpoint sufficiency from endpoint uniqueness.  Once the left beta-normalization anchor `y(0)=0` is admitted, any one nonzero strict node anchor `y(log d*)=(4/5)log d*` with `d*>1` pins the affine kernel, because the determinant of `[[1,0],[1,log d*]]` is `log d*>0`.  The finite audit checks every `d*=2..11`: each node reconstructs `delta=4/5`, `eta=9/5`, and all strict nodes `d=1..11` with zero residual within arithmetic tolerance.

fundamental_action_reconstruction/STRICT_EQUATION_SHEET_KERNEL_TO_LTOTAL_CURRENT.md:1795:`P2523/S1473` turns the P2522 node-pair basis equivalence into a basis-independent finite consistency audit.  For the strict target node data `y_d=(4/5)log d` on `d=1..11`, all 55 pairwise secants have slope `4/5`, all 165 triangle additive `y`-cocycles vanish, and the affine projection on columns `[1, log(d)]` recovers intercept `0`, slope `4/5`, hence `beta=1`, `eta=9/5`, with zero residual within arithmetic tolerance.
